full_name: Marjorie J. Spruill | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2006–2007 History Hrdy Fellow University of South Carolina
bio: Marjorie J. Spruill is an associate professor of history at the University of South Carolina with research and teaching interests in US women’s and gender history and the history of the American South.
